content:
{'original': 'Lenovo 推出咗色彩繽紛嘅新筆電 IdeaPad Vibe，挑戰 MacBook Neo。', 'translation': 'Lenovo has launched a colourful new laptop, the IdeaPad Vibe, to take on the MacBook Neo.'}

{'original': 'Lenovo 喺 IFA 舉行前嘅 Lenovo Innovation World 活動上發表咗 IdeaPad Vibe，目標明確對準 Apple 售價最親民、人氣極高嘅 MacBook Neo。從規格睇，呢部筆電絕對有力一戰。用戶可以選擇配備 14 吋或 15 吋 OLED 屏幕，機身厚度為 14.9mm，重量由 2.87 磅起。雖然比 Apple 嘅筆電厚同大，但起碼喺起步重量上就唔算重太多。Lenovo 表示 Vibe 將會提供塑膠同金屬兩種機身版本。', 'translation': "Lenovo unveiled the IdeaPad Vibe at its Lenovo Innovation World event ahead of IFA, with a clear target set on Apple's most affordable and wildly popular MacBook Neo. Judging by the specs, this laptop absolutely has what it takes to compete. Users can choose between 14-inch or 15-inch OLED displays; the chassis measures 14.9mm thick and starts at 2.87 pounds. Although it's thicker and larger than Apple's laptop, at least the starting weight isn't all that much heavier. Lenovo says the Vibe will be available in both plastic and metal chassis options."}

{'original': '不過佢嘅外型確實幾搶眼，Lenovo 同 Pantone 合作，為 IdeaPad Vibe 提供咗 7 種唔同嘅顏色選擇，包括：', 'translation': 'But the design is certainly eye-catching — Lenovo has partnered with Pantone to offer the IdeaPad Vibe in seven different colours, including:'}

{'original': '夢幻紫：一種柔和嘅紫色調，融入咗迷人嘅層次感，散發平靜氣息，無論去到邊都帶畀人一種舒適感。辛辣金：一種濃郁嘅金黃色，揉合溫暖同活力，營造出自信同親和嘅感覺。禪意綠：一種深受自然啟發嘅綠色調，散發平衡、和諧嘅氣息，令人放慢步伐。冰感藍：一種冷冽嘅藍色，帶有簡約時尚嘅氣息，激發清爽嘅清晰感同輕鬆重新開始嘅能量。耀眼珊瑚：溫暖又振奮人心，加入樂觀嘅橙色調，無論去到邊都帶畀人友善同正面嘅感覺。神秘藍：深藍色調彰顯可信同自信，傳遞優雅嘅氣質。低調灰：經典嘅灰色，散發力量、穩定同內斂嘅成熟感。', 'translation': 'Dreamy Purple: a soft purple hue with captivating dimension that radiates a calming energy and brings a sense of ease wherever it goes. Spicy Gold: a rich, golden tone blending warmth and vitality for a confident, approachable feel. Zen Green: a nature-inspired green that exudes balance and harmony, inviting you to slow down. Icy Blue: a cool blue with a minimalist flair that sparks crisp clarity and a refreshing sense of new beginnings. Radiant Coral: warm and uplifting with an optimistic orange twist, spreading friendly, positive vibes wherever it goes. Mystery Blue: a deep blue tone conveying trust and confidence with an air of elegance. Understated Grey: a classic grey radiating strength, stability and quiet sophistication.'}

{'original': '鍵盤仲配備可更換鍵帽，等你可以配搭出唔同嘅色彩組合，自訂個人風格。', 'translation': 'The keyboard also features swappable keycaps, letting you mix and match different colour combinations to suit your personal style.'}

{'original': '不過靚嘅顏色始終有限，Lenovo 為呢部筆電裝備咗相當吸引嘅配置：兩個 USB-A 插口、一個 HDMI 插口、兩個 USB-C 插口、一個耳機插口，甚至仲有 microSD 讀卡器。配備 500 萬像素鏡頭嘅視像鏡頭（設有實體私隱遮蓋）、可選嘅鍵盤背光，以及 15 吋型號獨有嘅可選觸控屏幕。', 'translation': "Good looks only go so far, though, and Lenovo has packed this laptop with a pretty tempting set of ports: two USB-A ports, one HDMI port, two USB-C ports, a headphone jack and even a microSD card reader. There's also a 5-megapixel webcam (with a physical privacy shutter), optional keyboard backlighting, and an optional touchscreen exclusive to the 15-inch model."}

{'original': '但內裡嘅規格又如何呢？', 'translation': 'But what about the specs on the inside?'}

{'original': '用戶可以選擇 AMD Ryzen AI 400 晶片或 Qualcomm Snapdragon X 晶片。AMD 型號支援高達 32GB RAM，而且用戶可以自行升級。配置仲包括高達 1TB 儲存空間，同樣可以升級，並設有雙插槽。Snapdragon 版本支援高達 24GB RAM，儲存空間雖然仍可升級，但 RAM 就唔可以。Lenovo 表示日後仲會推出 Intel 版本。', 'translation': 'Users can opt for either an AMD Ryzen AI 400 chip or a Qualcomm Snapdragon X chip. The AMD model supports up to 32GB of RAM and is user-upgradeable. Storage goes up to 1TB, which is also upgradeable and features dual slots. The Snapdragon version supports up to 24GB of RAM; the storage remains upgradeable, but the RAM is not. Lenovo says an Intel version will arrive later down the line.'}

{'original': 'Lenovo IdeaPad Vibe 將分兩階段開賣。AMD 型號將於 10 月開售，Snapdragon 型號則喺 11 月緊隨其後。兩者定價都由 $699.99 美元起，自 Apple 因 RAM 加價後，呢個價位同 MacBook Neo 睇齊。', 'translation': "The Lenovo IdeaPad Vibe will go on sale in two waves. The AMD model will be available in October, followed by the Snapdragon model in November. Both start at $699.99 — a price that now matches the MacBook Neo following Apple's RAM price hikes."}

{'original': '另一方面，Lenovo 同時推出咗 IdeaCentre AIO I 桌面式一體機，配備 24 吋或 27 吋屏幕，提供同 Vibe 相似嘅顏色，定價由 $939 美元起。該產品同樣會喺 11 月起開始發售。', 'translation': 'On another front, Lenovo has also launched the IdeaCentre AIO I, an all-in-one desktop available with 24-inch or 27-inch displays, offered in similar colours to the Vibe and starting at $939. The product will likewise begin shipping from November.'}

{'original': '更多 Lenovo 相關報道：', 'translation': 'More Lenovo coverage:'}

  • {'original': 'Lenovo 首批 RTX Spark 筆電配備高達 128GB RAM', 'translation': "Lenovo's first RTX Spark laptops pack up to 128GB of RAM"}
  • {'original': '喺 RAM 荒之中，Lenovo 嘅 Snapdragon X2 Windows 筆電值得你留意', 'translation': "Amid the RAM crunch, Lenovo's Snapdragon X2 Windows laptops are worth a look"}
  • {'original': 'Lenovo 全新 rugged Android 平板配備可拆式電池，現以 $499 美元開賣', 'translation': "Lenovo's new rugged Android tablet with a swappable battery is now on sale for $499"}
